cases.title: Verify Badge Form Initial Display and Required Fields
cases.description: Access the application and verify that the 'badgeForm' is visible with all required input fields ('eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company'), the select dropdown ('access'), and the 'generate-badge-button' across various screen sizes without horizontal scrolling.

cases.title: Form Submission with Missing Fields
cases.description: Attempt to click 'generate-badge-button' with one or more empty required fields and verify that the form remains visible while the badge and download button are not displayed.

cases.title: Successful Badge Generation and Dynamic Field Update
cases.description: Fill out all form fields with valid inputs, including minimum lengths and select an Access Level, then click 'generate-badge-button'. Verify that 'formContainer' is hidden, the badge section is displayed with updated details (Event Name, Person Name, Designation, Company Name prefixed with '@', and Access Level), and the QR code and 'dwnBadge' button are enabled.

cases.title: QR Code Content and Unique ID Generation
cases.description: Submit the valid badge form and inspect the generated QR code text content to ensure it includes a unique ID and follows the exact specified format including all entered details.

cases.title: Badge Download Functionality as PNG Image
cases.description: After successfully generating a badge, click the 'dwnBadge' button and verify that the html-to-image library successfully converts the badge HTML element into a PNG image and initiates the download via a data URL link.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements clearly, distinct scenarios are well-defined, and there are no blockers or untestable requirements identified.
All requirements and cases are well-defined, clear, and fully testable based on the provided specifications.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_30-R-1: Normal path: Access application and verify visibility of 'badgeForm' containing required fields 'eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company', 'access', and 'generate-badge-button' without horizontal scrolling across all screen sizes. Boundaries: Small screen responsive layouts. Abnormal path: Missing required fields or improper layout rendering.

e2edev_bench_30-R-2: Normal path: Populate all required fields ('eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company') and select 'access' ('Attendee' or 'VIP'), click 'generate-badge-button', hide 'formContainer', display 'badge' with details, QR code, and visible 'dwnBadge'. Abnormal path: Leave any field empty; form remains visible, and badge/download button are hidden.

e2edev_bench_30-R-3: Normal path: Input valid details and click 'generate-badge-button' to update 'badgeEvent', 'badgeName', 'badgeDesignation', 'badgecontainer' (Company Name prefixed with '@'), 'badgeAccess', and 'qrcode'. Enable 'dwnBadge'. Boundaries: Minimum input lengths for fields. Abnormal path: Invalid or edge-case string lengths.

e2edev_bench_30-R-4: Normal path: Submit form to generate a unique ID and render QR code matching format 'ID: IDxxxx\nEvent: [Event Name]\nName: [Person Name]\nDesignation: [Designation]\nCompany: @[Company Name]\nAccess: [Access Level]'. Hide 'formContainer' and trigger html-to-image conversion via 'dwnBadge'. Abnormal path: Incorrect QR format or generation failure.

e2edev_bench_30-R-6: Normal path: Successfully submit completed form fields to display badge section and make 'dwnBadge' visible. Clicking 'dwnBadge' creates a link element with data URL href and triggers download. Abnormal path: Clicking download without badge generation or missing fields.

e2edev_bench_30-R-7: Normal path: Fill form, generate badge with QR code, and click 'dwnBadge' to download PNG image via html-to-image. Boundaries: Large text content. Abnormal path: Errors during image conversion or faulty download triggers.
